policy: Protocol-neutral by default. Candidate adapters require independent design review, version pinning, permission mapping, and tests.

candidates.name: Model Context Protocol
candidates.purpose: Potential interface for model-to-tool and model-to-resource interoperability.

candidates.name: Agent2Agent
candidates.purpose: Potential interface for agent discovery and task collaboration.

candidates.name: OpenAPI
candidates.purpose: Potential description format for HTTP service interfaces.

candidates.name: JSON-RPC
candidates.purpose: Potential transport-neutral request and response envelope.

requirements: No protocol adapter may bypass local policy decisions.
Remote identity and authentication must be explicit.
Network destinations and data disclosures must be declared.
Timeouts, retries, cancellation, and idempotency must be defined.
Protocol support must not be claimed until a tested adapter exists.
